description: Node.js / TypeScript (npm, pnpm, yarn or bun; jest, vitest, mocha, node --test, karma)
build_cmd: <pm> run build (when package.json has a build script; else <pm> exec tsc --noEmit for TypeScript)
test_filter_hint: jest/vitest: <pm> test -- <file or -t name>; node --test: node --test <file>; mocha: <pm> exec mocha <file>
format_cmd: <pm> exec prettier --check <changed files> (when prettier is configured)
